# telnyx_portout_supporting_documents (Data Source)

The supporting documents of a port-out request.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

- `id` (String) The id id.

### Optional

### Read-Only

- `portout_supporting_documents` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--portout_supporting_documents))
